questions.prompt: I usually ______ at 6:30, but I stay in bed for another ten minutes.
questions.explanation: “Wake up” means to stop sleeping. “Get up” means to leave the bed.

questions.prompt: After I wake up, I usually ______ right away and take a shower.
questions.explanation: “Get up” means to leave your bed or stand up.

questions.prompt: My daily ______ takes about forty minutes by bus.
questions.explanation: A “commute” is the regular trip between home and work or school.

questions.prompt: I need to ______ after work: go to the bank, buy groceries, and pick up a package.
questions.explanation: “Run errands” means to make several short trips to complete practical tasks.

questions.prompt: I try to ______ three times a week to stay healthy.
I was exhausted, so I decided to ______ early.
questions.explanation: “Go to bed” means to get into bed because you intend to sleep.
When an alarm “goes off,” it starts making a sound.

questions.prompt: I only had twenty minutes, but I managed to ______ a quick workout.
questions.explanation: “Squeeze in” means to find time for something in a busy schedule.

questions.prompt: Na verdade, eu trabalho de casa às sextas-feiras.
questions.answer: Actually, I work from home on Fridays.|Actually, I work from home Fridays.
questions.explanation: Use “actually” to correct, clarify, or add information. It does not mean “currently.”

questions.prompt: No fim, eu consegui terminar tudo.
questions.answer: Eventually, I managed to finish everything.|I eventually managed to finish everything.
